sentences.text: The appellant has filed this present misc. second appeal under Section 71(6) of the Food Safety and Standard Act 2006 in which the appellant has filed I.A No.9647/2025 under Section 5 of the limitation Act.

It has been stated in the said application that the impugned order was passed on 24.07.2025 however, the appellant came to the knowledge about passing of the order on 23.09.2025 and thereafter, he has filed this appeal on 25.09.2025 therefore, there is a delay of 01 day in filing this appeal.
Considering the aforesaid reasons mentioned in the application, the delay of 01 day in filing this appeal is hereby condoned.
I.A No.9646/2025 is allowed and disposed off.
Let record be requisitioned from both the Court below.
As soon as the records are received, Registry is directed to scan and upload the same in the ERP within 15 days.
